state:
**Goal `ldap`, Stage 7 (writes and passwords): `add`, `modify`, `delete`, `rename`, `setPassword`, `changePassword` and `Ldap\Change` are on `main`, and `compare` is the stage's open item.** Stages 1 to 5 are done, and Stage 4 is done except for a CA that a program supplies. Stage 6 is done except wiring the schema into the readers. Of Stage 7's checks, every one passes against `samba-ad` except `compare_returns_a_bool_and_throws_on_error`, which is not written.

**On `main`**: everything Stage 6 listed, plus `nvs_ldap::Connection::modify`/`add`/`delete`/`rename`/`compare`/`set_password`/`change_password`, `nvs_ldap::conn::unicode_pwd`, and `crate::ldap::write` (the Novis bodies and `encoded`, the value table). A password write on a connection without TLS is `EncryptionRequired` before a byte is sent. A result 19 or 53 whose diagnostic opens with `0000052D:` or carries `data 52D` is `PasswordPolicy`. `Connection::compare` exists on the wire and has no Novis member yet.

Server cases reach `samba-ad` (`tests/db/compose.yaml`) at `ldaps://localhost:16636`, and plain LDAP at 16389. Write cases add and delete their own entries, and each case and test uses its own names because the cases run at the same time: OUs `Shop`/`Blog`/`Store`/`Framework`/`Example` at the root, and each test user `CN=<name>,OU=<name>` in an OU of its own (`Team`, `Editors` in Rust, `Staff`, `Authors` in cases), never under `CN=Users`, whose entries two cases count.

items.text: **`compare(Dn|string, string $attribute, mixed $value): bool`** (ADR 0278 § 9). `nvs_ldap::Connection::compare` at `crates/nvs-ldap/src/conn.rs:517` is written; the Novis body goes beside `nvs_core_ldap_connection_change_password` at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/write.rs:489` and encodes the value with `encoded` at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/write.rs:173`, and the row goes after `changePassword` at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/registry.rs:422`. A list value is a `LogicError`: compare takes one value. Closes `compare_returns_a_bool_and_throws_on_error`, and needs three `.nvst` cases calling `->compare(`.

**The readers take the base type from the schema** (`rule:core-classes/ldap-value-types`), Stage 6's last item. `crate::ldap::schema` is at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/mod.rs:609`; an `Ldap\Entry` cannot reach its connection, so either it carries the key or `search` reads the schema when it builds the entry.

backlog: A server round trip for a `Uuid`, a `Sid`, an `Instant` and a `Duration` through `modify`: the OU entries the cases use have no writable attribute of those syntaxes (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/write.rs` module doc).
A CA that a program supplies to `Ldap::open` (Stage 4, ADR 0278 § 2).
Stage 9's Global Catalog `ReadOnly` refusal goes in `crate::ldap::write` before a byte is sent (ADR 0278 § 11).
